summary: Tested the new multi-service pivot (Cleaning Service Wels, German UI) end to end. Backend: 25/25 pytest checks pass. They cover services (6), settings, hourly pricing with materials and discount, the min/max hours check, quote bookings, MOCK pay, the PDF invoice (RE-YYYY-NNNN, number stays the same on repeat calls, company/IBAN data correct), profile, and admin settings/services CRUD/status. Frontend at 390x844: these flows work: onboarding (Weiter x3 -> Los geht's, Überspringen, revisiting / goes to /home), the 4 tabs, the WhatsApp FAB hidden only on Buchen, the greeting and promo banner, category tiles -> filtered Services, filters, detail -> Buchen with the service preselected, the 3-step hourly booking (hours +/- limited to min..12, materials +€10, WILLKOMMEN10, consent gate) -> checkout (4242 success, 4000..0002 declined message in German) -> success with invoice download (opens a popup), the quote booking -> 'Anfrage gesendet!', profile saving after reload, the materials toggle saving, the profile data filled in on Buchen step 3, history with pay/invoice buttons, the Rechnungen tab, the info/faq/privacy/admin links, the admin agenda label 'Angebot angefr.', and the admin materials fee editor (changed to 12 and set back to 10). Issues found: the pay button shows a rounded amount, a confirmed quote gets a €0 'already paid' invoice, the backend has no validation of the booking date/time/required fields, and backend error texts are in Spanish. Deprecated packages: none found (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch). SafeAreaView comes from react-native-safe-area-context, which is correct.

minor.issue: PAID_STATUSES includes 'confirmed'. When the admin confirms a quote_requested booking (NEXT_STATUS quote_requested->confirmed), the endpoint creates an invoice of €0.00 with an invoice number and the text 'Der Betrag wurde online beglichen'. The booking also shows up in the customer's Rechnungen tab. Fix: only allow invoices for pricing=='hourly' with payment_ref/paid_at set, or for final_price>0. Verified: 200 application/pdf RE-2026-0006 for a confirmed quote.

No validation of the input. It accepts past dates (2020-01-01), invalid times (99:99) and empty device_id/customer_name/customer_phone/address (returns 200). Add Pydantic constraints (min_length, date >= today, HH:MM inside allowed slots).

Accepts a negative price, pricing='weird' and category='Foo' (200). Validate with Literal['hourly','quote'] and the allowed categories, and require price>=0. min_hours can be above 12, which makes the service impossible to book.

Error messages are still in Spanish although the UI is fully German: 'Servicio no encontrado', 'Cita no encontrada', 'Esta cita ya está pagada' (also returned when paying a quote booking), 'Número de tarjeta inválido', 'CVC inválido', 'Nombre del titular requerido', 'Tarjeta rechazada', 'Credenciales inválidas', 'No autorizado', 'Token inválido/expirado', 'Estado inválido'.

The invoice year comes from the current date, not from paid_at. The invoice_counter is global and never resets per year. The PDF has no VAT/USt line and no Kleinunternehmer note (§6 Abs 1 Z 27 UStG), which Austrian invoices need. '54383/3172' looks like a Steuernummer, not a UID (ATU...).
No X-Device-Id header check (the id sits in the path), which is not consistent with the other device-protected endpoints. The invoice URL also puts device_id in the query string.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses toFixed(0): shows '€77 bezahlen & bestätigen' while the total is €76.50. Reference: app/checkout.tsx:240

integration_issues.issue: Promise.all([listServices, settings, getProfile]) has no catch. If any call fails, the service list stays empty and no error is shown. Reference: app/(tabs)/book.tsx:64-80

issues: While scrolling, the WhatsApp FAB covers interactive content: the 'Rechnungen' segment tab, the price and chevron of invoice rows, and part of the Home 'Dach & PV' tile. Content stays reachable at the end of the scroll (paddingBottom 120).
The slides are text only, which leaves a large empty white area. Consider adding an illustration, icon or the logo per slide.
materials-switch is 40x20px. Make the whole row pressable or meet the 44pt touch target.
The primary CTA 'Route in Maps anzeigen' does not fit the customer's situation, since it is their own address.

action_items: Change the checkout pay button (and the admin card/stat prices) to toFixed(2) or euro() so the paid amount matches the total exactly
Block invoices for quote bookings, or for bookings without payment_ref/final_price>0, so confirming a quote does not create a €0 'paid' invoice or show it under Rechnungen

Add Pydantic validation on BookingCreate (non-empty name/phone/address/device_id, date not in the past, valid time slot) and on ServiceCreate/Update (pricing Literal, allowed categories, price>=0, min_hours<=12)
Translate the remaining Spanish HTTPException details to German
Invoice PDF: add a USt line or Kleinunternehmer note and check the UID/Steuernummer label; take the invoice year from paid_at
Add a catch/error state on the book.tsx initial load
Fix the WhatsApp FAB overlapping list content on the Profile/Home tabs
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has 864 lines (>700). Split it into routers (bookings, admin, invoice/pdf, profile).
A booking with a scheduled_date in the past passes without any check.
send_booking_notification is skipped because SendGrid is not configured (by design).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; pay-button rounding display bug)

seed_data_creation: Test bookings/profiles with prefix TEST were created and then removed from MongoDB (35 bookings, 4 profiles). materials_fee was set back to 10.0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env; pytest backend/tests/test_multiservice_v7.py. The frontend .env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. On web the device id is in localStorage key 'device_id' (JSON string) and the onboarding flag in 'onboarded'. Admin login is rate-limited to 5/min/IP. The container date is Nov 2026.
rca_of_issue: Pay button: checkout.tsx:240 formats with toFixed(0). €0 quote invoice: the invoice endpoint gates only on status in PAID_STATUSES, and the admin NEXT_STATUS maps quote_requested->confirmed, which is in PAID_STATUSES.
